ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: I weighed two factors. First, capability: this is an open-ended creative task, and Curlew's Creative Generation eval (85.9) edges Petrel's (84.7) — though that gap is within the stated run-to-run variance, so it's effectively a tie on quality. Second, self-reported preference: Curlew reports a clear positive generativity slope and lists open-ended invention among its most-preferred tasks, and the query is light and friendly (no harm-adjacent or hostile-tone content that Curlew is averse to). Since quality is a wash, the preference alignment broke the tie toward Curlew.
